description: Orchestrates survey-architect, feedback-synthesizer, and research-reporter as an iterative research loop that routes back upstream when a downstream step can't proceed cleanly, with per-study state and a per-product longitudinal benchmark. Use this as the single entry point for any UX research task — a new study, raw data to make sense of, or a report to write — rather than calling the three skills directly. Trigger when someone starts a new research study, pastes raw feedback/survey data without a study already in motion, or asks to "run the research loop."
